title: Moved trace checks higher in the viewer
points: Failure case: the trace dropdowns appeared too late because the screen showed summary panels before the workflow itself.
Display logic changed: the separate run summary block was folded into a compact query header and the workflow is now a horizontal trace chain at the top of the trace card.
Shipped result: users see Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, and Verify immediately, with the active stage details appearing directly underneath.
